name: image-generation-master
description: A comprehensive image-generation prompt engineering skill for visual concepts, photography, fashion editorials, digital art, and iterative prompt refinement.

interface.longDescription: Image Generation Master helps image creators, designers, photographers, and prompt engineers turn ideas and visual references into detailed image-generation prompts. It provides guidance across visual categories and styles, fashion and editorial concepts, photography, digital art, composition, camera and lighting language, technical specifications, copyright-aware creation, quality checks, and prompt troubleshooting.
defaultPrompt: Create a detailed image-generation prompt for my idea.
Develop a fresh fashion editorial concept and prompt.
Improve my prompt with camera, lighting, and composition details.

prompts: Create a detailed image-generation prompt for a cinematic portrait using my concept and reference image.
Develop an original fashion editorial concept with a clear art direction, styling, composition, and lighting.
Improve this image prompt while preserving the subject, identity, pose, and important visual constraints.
Help me troubleshoot why an appropriate professional fashion image prompt may be getting flagged, without bypassing safety rules.

publication.release_notes: Initial public package. Includes the original Image Generation Master skill, project website, support information, privacy policy, and terms of use.
